tools.name: demo_start_session
tools.description: Open an isolated temporary demo portfolio workspace. No login required. Call once per conversation; retain guest_session for later tools.

tools.name: demo_end_session
tools.description: Delete this temporary demo workspace.

tools.name: demo_capabilities
tools.description: Read the actual tool catalogue, storage limits and currently enabled calculation methods.

tools.name: demo_prepared_case
tools.description: Read the synthetic six-position input template when prepared_case_available is true; this computes no price.

tools.name: demo_workbench
tools.description: Open the owned portfolio/market workbench and show valid next actions.

tools.name: demo_list_entities
tools.description: List your saved book/market heads without rendering a new workbench.

tools.name: demo_get_version
tools.description: Read your immutable book or market snapshot; omit version for its current head.

tools.name: demo_create_book
tools.description: Create a bounded sandbox portfolio; this does not book a production trade.

tools.name: demo_edit_position
tools.description: Add, replace, remove or clone a position using an exact book-version guard.

tools.name: demo_create_market
tools.description: Save a complete immutable market/fixing snapshot with explicit conventions.

tools.name: demo_replace_market
tools.description: Create a new market version while retaining the original snapshot.

tools.name: demo_market_factors
tools.description: List exact shockable factors and raw input units in your selected market version.

tools.name: demo_stress_market
tools.description: Save an explicit market-shock case. No price or stress P&L is calculated by this operation.

tools.name: demo_advance_market
tools.description: Save an advanced valuation date with supplied fixings. Each product still needs dated-state qualification.

tools.name: demo_export_case
tools.description: Export exact owned book/market versions and their hashes for reproduction, with input-binding status.

tools.name: demo_price_book
tools.description: Queue the selected portfolio using exact saved versions and an admitted method. Read actual per-trade kernel and timings from demo_get_job; use matching work when comparing timings.

tools.name: demo_get_job
tools.description: Read immutable portfolio/trade results and measured kernel/timing evidence. recording_count is cumulative per kernel; kernel.kind and this job recording/workspace timings show whether it recorded.

tools.name: demo_cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel your queued/running calculation; late worker results cannot be published.

tools.name: demo_replay_job
tools.description: Queue the saved numerical recipe as a new calculation. It may reuse a retained kernel or record again; verify actual kernel/timing evidence. An admitted cache-policy-only release change carries explicit replay_source provenance.

tools.name: demo_export_result
tools.description: Export your completed result, exact saved recipe and content hashes for reproduction.

tools.name: demo_inspect_result
tools.description: Inspect your saved complete portfolio, selected group or trade: unit results, signed values/first risks, timing and memory with exact saved versions.

tools.name: demo_explain_market_change
tools.description: Explain the same-date market change between two owned complete AADC results using their actual first risks, full revaluation and retained residual.

tools.name: demo_revaluation_waterfall
tools.description: Reconcile an explicitly ordered same-date sequence of your saved complete revaluations, including market and position changes.

tools.name: demo_explain_gas_date_change
tools.description: Explain one selected gas trade from admitted day0 to day1 with observed cash and historical financing, in explicit numeraires.

tools.name: demo_trace_trade
tools.description: Queue a single-path Tracer diagnostic for one explicit trade in your saved AADC pricing job; pair with its original AADC path.

tools.name: demo_get_trace
tools.description: Read your selected product diagnostic job status and completed source/function/output evidence.

tools.name: demo_export_trace
tools.description: Export your owned product trace with immutable selected pricing trade, market/book recipe and paired evidence.

tools.name: demo_cancel_trace
tools.description: Cancel your queued or running product diagnostic; late results cannot be published.

tools.name: demo_compare_traces
tools.description: Compare matched owned selected-path outputs and legacy source/expression summaries. Use demo_inspect_trace and demo_compare_trace_values for captured rich diagnostic intermediate values; operation IDs remain local to each recording.

tools.name: demo_inspect_trace
tools.description: Read an owned saved trace. Omit query for captured valued reports, economic stages and available SDK queries; exact saved queries only, no new computation.

tools.name: demo_compare_trace_values
tools.description: Compare two owned saved diagnostic-valued traces after exact model/source/draw compatibility checks. Qualified semantic/source-site alignment only; no cross-record entry-ID matching.
